recs.stt: “Cold Tube” cooling system uses half the energy of an air conditioner
recs.x:
Portable air conditioners are bad. All the hot components are in the room with you and it takes air from the room and blows it outside.

Technology Connections has a good video about this: [link]

Window units or "split" systems are far more efficient and work much better, at the downside of cost and installation fees.

Technology Connections has a very good video (with perhaps excessive detail, but it is very interesting) about them, here: [link]
